verdict.rationale: Lago documents first-party AI agents inside the product. A plain-language billing agent lets users manage billing by description, and a Dunning Agent reads twelve months of each customer's invoices, payments and disputes before acting, then hands remaining cases to a person. That is AI reasoning over the user's own data, but it is aimed at taking actions, not at surfacing insights or recommendations; the MCP server only exposes data to external assistants and the analytics dashboards are not AI-driven. Missing for 10: explicit in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions (e.g., revenue or anomaly recommendations), documentation of how those insights are presented in the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: With our AI agent, you manage billing by describing what you need in plain language.
The Dunning Agent reads the account first: twelve months of invoices and payments, the disputes, the provider status.
It reads each customer's payment history before it chases, and hands the rest to a person.
